note: Apply the rows with counted=true (verified=true is the same; action is then the proposed action): tag_answer (set the category of OPD document opd_doc_id to target_category), extract_tag (extract the text of OPD document opd_doc_id, set target_category), fetch (fetch source_url, attach, set target_category). counted=false rows have action=review: tier identity_wording_only (Jura: no date check) and tier review (review_reason) are for a person. text_sha256 is the hash of the text the checks read; check_detail carries the route, identity and date class, the sha256 of the document read, the extractor and a quote of at most 200 characters.
precedence: Where a list in results/repair names the same affair, the adapter list wins over the older OCR candidate rows (results/repair/repair_<BODY>.tsv, action=ocr); the Bern lists and the Valais retype_oral list have no adapter counterpart. All lists and the rule: results/repair/MANIFEST.json.

retier.note: logged re-tiering (repair/adapters/retier.py): these counted rows are NOT to be applied; they are review rows (confirm identity, attach, keep OPD's event dates). The lists stay byte-identical to the committed ones.
